description: Defines the ReportingReport struct and related enums and methods for handling reporting reports in the net namespace.

classes.name: ReportingReport
classes.description: Represents an undelivered reporting report with status, identifiers, URL, body, and delivery info.

methods.name: ReportingReport
methods.description: Constructor initializing a report with source, key, URL, user agent, group, type, body, depth, queued time, and attempts.

methods.name: GetGroupKey
methods.description: Returns a key combining the report's network anonymization key, URL origin, and group.

methods.name: RecordReportDiscardedForNoURLRequestContext
methods.description: Static method to record discarding of report due to no URL request context.

methods.name: RecordReportDiscardedForNoReportingService
methods.description: Static method to record discarding of report due to no reporting service.

methods.name: IsUploadPending
methods.description: Checks if the report is currently part of an ongoing upload attempt.
